items.source: Creates a new configurer that will configure the connection factory using the given properties and connectionDetails, with the latter taking priority.
items.translation: 创建一个使用给定的 `properties` 和 `connectionDetails（后者具有优先级）来配置连接工厂的新配置器。

items.source: Configures the given connectionFactory using the given rabbitProperties.
items.translation: 使用给定的 rabbitProperties 配置给定的 connectionFactory。

items.source: Creates a new configurer that will configure the connection factory using the given properties.
items.translation: 创建一个使用给定 properties 配置连接工厂的新配置器。

items.source: properties - the properties to use to configure the connection factory
items.translation: properties - 用于配置连接工厂的属性

items.source: Can be injected into application code and used to define a custom CachingConnectionFactory whose configuration is based upon that produced by auto-configuration.
items.translation: 可注入到应用程序代码中，用于定义自定义的`CachingConnectionFactory`，其配置基于自动配置所产生的配置。

items.source: connectionDetails - the connection details to use to configure the connection factory
items.translation: connectionDetails - 用于配置连接工厂的连接详细信息

items.source: rabbitProperties - properties to use for the configuration
